info.title: dotnet-outdated
info.description: A .NET Core global tool to update project dependencies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A .NET Core global tool to list outdated Nuget packages.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --include-auto-references
options.description: Specifies whether to include auto-referenced packages. [default: False]

options.name: --pre-release
options.description: Specifies whether to look for pre-release versions of packages. Possible values: Auto (default), Always or Never. [default: Auto]

options.name: --version-lock
options.description: Specifies whether the package should be locked to the current Major or Minor version. Possible values: None (default), Major or Minor. [default: None]

options.name: --transitive
options.description: Specifies whether it should detect transitive dependencies. [default: False]

options.name: --transitive-depth
options.description: Defines how many levels deep transitive dependencies should be analyzed. Integer value (default = 1) [default: 1]

options.name: --upgrade
options.description: Specifies whether outdated packages should be upgraded. Possible values for <TYPE> is Auto (default) or Prompt, given as -u:<TYPE>.

options.name: --fail-on-updates
options.description: Specifies whether it should return a non-zero exit code when updates are found. [default: False]

options.name: --include
options.description: Specifies to only look at packages where the name contains the provided string. Culture and case insensitive. If provided multiple times, a single match is enough to include a package. [default: System.Collections.Generic.List`1[System.String]]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Specifies to only look at packages where the name does not contain the provided string. Culture and case insensitive. If provided multiple times, a single match is enough to exclude a package. [default: System.Collections.Generic.List`1[System.String]]

options.name: --output
options.description: Specifies the filename for a generated report. (Use the -of|--output-format option to specify the format. JSON by default.)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Specifies the output format for the generated report. Possible values: json (default), csv, or markdown. [default: Json]

options.name: --older-than
options.description: Only include package versions that are older than the specified number of days. [default: 0]

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Add the reference without performing restore preview and compatibility check. [default: False]

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively search for all projects within the provided directory. [default: False]

options.name: --include-file-based-apps
options.description: Include loose file-based apps when recursively searching a directory. [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-failed-sources
options.description: Treat package source failures as warnings. [default: False]

options.name: --include-up-to-date
options.description: Include all dependencies in the report even the ones not outdated. [default: False]

options.name: --pre-release-label
options.description: Specifies an optional label to restrict matches to when looking for pre-release versions of packages. For example, a label of 'rc.1' would only match pre-release packages with a pre-release label that starts with that prefix. [default: ]

options.name: --nuget-cred-log-level
options.description: Specifies the minimum level of logs for NuGet Credential Service. Possible values: debug, verbose, information, warning (default), or error [default: Warning]

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Specifies an optional runtime identifier to be used during the restore target when projects are analyzed. More information available on https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/rid-catalog [default: ]

options.name: --maximum-version
options.description: The inclusive maximum package version to upgrade to. For example, a value of '8.0' would upgrade System.Text.Json 6.0.0 to the latest patch version of 8.0.x [default: ]

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Specifies the idle timeout in seconds to wait for output from the dotnet executable before assuming it has hung. Default is 120 seconds. [default: 120]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The path to a .sln, .slnx, .slnf, .csproj, .fsproj or .cs file-based app, or to a directory containing a .NET Core solution/project. If none is specified, the current directory will be used.
